scope: one rustc GlobalCtxt for each Cargo library/test compilation; baseline whole analysis, each accepted source scalar-tail override then checkpoint repair, full analysis and all named function type/borrow roots demanded at every revision
important_limitation: Fresh comparison is separate and only claims stated diagnostic fields; timings, when recorded, were measured in a development machine with other work running and are not an isolated end-to-end Cargo benchmark.

fresh_comparison.comparison: code, diagnostic message, primary crate-relative file/start line/label; error range end and source display not compared because the resident scalar edit preserves the previous HIR tail span
